author: DickyChant
body:
#### PR description:

It is very useful to make use of `CloseByParticleGun` to test the calorimeter response to particles, as the particles can be produced next to the calorimeter and therefore don't have to travel through the tracker, etc. that undergoes a certain material budget.

However, for FastSIM workflows, this cannot be easily achieved, because in FastSIM, tracks play an essential role and are therefore assumed to be present. Thus, usually in FastSIM, a precaution is taken to not allow a particle that gets produced outside of the tracker. Hence, the `CloseByParticleGun` sample cannot be produced for calorimeter FastSIM studies. 

This PR tries to add a few lines that allow for exceptions where particles are not from the tracker volume but are around the calorimeter surface. 

#### PR validation:

I tried some jobs, and the intended outputs can be produced. In particular, I have included the configuration:`barrel_closeby_fastsim_cfg.py`, which has photons from the ECAL barrel face (r = 130 cm) that, IMO, validate the implementation in the barrel region, whose fastsim status is relatively more stable.
title: [FastSIM] Introducing Support for CloseByParticleGun production (for Calorimeter)
